name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success | AI Agents & Automation | B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and account leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS who builds and tunes AI agents hands-on. As founder of Solenzo, designs LLM-based agent workflows, translates business owners' goals into precise prompts and agent logic, and evaluates AI output against rubric-based standards. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye by tracking utilization and catching risk early, onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets, and advised C-suite clients at Accelo while ranking top three in sales. Runs structured discovery, business reviews, and value reporting tied to measurable outcomes.

experience.title: AI Automation Lead (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Break manual workflows into AI agent architectures with custom logic that scores a business's digital footprint and generates personalized outreach.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' loosely defined goals into precise prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Evaluate AI-generated responses in client automation systems and built rubric-based grading criteria to score outputs against defined standards.
Built a 20+ workflow SMS and email automation system and track ROI and funnel results in dashboards for each client.
Run discovery with business owners, define measurable goals, and expand accounts through proposals and SOWs.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts and delivered QBRs tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion with recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, and fed prioritized feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total).

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation and 120% of sales targets.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8).

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
